headline: Meta has launched Muse Wonder, a new family of AI models whose larger version an independent ranking places second only to one Anthropic model.
score_reason: Pool score kept: a major lab launches a new model family with independent benchmark results, though one leaderboard is a single measure and Meta's safety report is still to come.
importance_line: People who pay for Meta's Muse assistant are due a stronger model and rival labs gain a new competitor near the top of one ranking, but the ranking is a single benchmark, the safety report is not yet out and the Muse app upgrade is promised rather than delivered.
summary: Mashable reports that Meta has launched Muse Wonder and a larger Muse Wonder Full, which Meta calls its most capable models to date and says are built for agentic tasks, meaning work an AI carries out over several steps, and that Artificial Analysis, an independent benchmarking group, ranks Muse Wonder Full second only to Anthropic's Claude Opus 5.5 Max and level with its Claude Sonnet 5.5 Max. Developers can use Muse Wonder now through Meta's API and its Muse Code tool, the Muse app is to get it soon for paying users only, and Meta says its full safety report will follow.
notes: Read in full on Mashable. Mashable relays benchmark results from Artificial Analysis and price details from CNBC; Meta's own announcement is quoted. Muse Wonder Full is the larger model.
